chunks.text: Coal India Limited - Annual Report 2023-24 (sample excerpt)

Directors' Report
Your Company achieved coal production of 773.81 million tonnes in 2023-24 against the annual target of 780 million tonnes, the highest ever. MCL and SECL together contributed more than half of the total. ECL recorded the highest growth among subsidiaries at over 28 per cent, driven by the ramp-up of the Rajmahal expansion. NEC's production remained constrained by pending forest clearances.
Production target and achievement, 2023-24 (figures in Million Tonnes)

Safety
The Company continued its focus on zero-harm mining. Safety audits by multidisciplinary teams, proximity warning devices on heavy earth-moving machinery, and real-time gas monitoring in underground mines were extended. Fatality rate per million tonnes of coal produced declined compared with the previous year.

Mine closure
Progressive and final mine closure plans are implemented under the guidelines of the Ministry of Coal. Reclaimed land is being developed as eco-parks, water bodies and plantations; 1,610 hectares were brought under biological reclamation during the year.

chunks.text: MINISTRY OF COAL LOK SABHA UNSTARRED QUESTION NO. 2150 TO BE ANSWERED ON 29.07.2024

COAL PRODUCTION BY CIL
2150. SHRI RAMESH KUMAR:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) the subsidiary-wise coal production of Coal India Limited during the last two years;
(b) whether the production target for 2023-24 has been achieved; and
(c) the steps taken to enhance production?

chunks.heading_path: THE MINISTER OF COAL AND MINES (SHRI G. KISHAN REDDY)
chunks.text:
THE MINISTER OF COAL AND MINES (SHRI G. KISHAN REDDY)
(a): The subsidiary-wise coal production of CIL during the last two years is given at Annexure-I.
(b): CIL produced 773.20 million tonnes (provisional) in 2023-24 against the target of 780 million tonnes, an achievement of about 99 per cent.
(c): Steps taken include expediting environment and forest clearances, capacity expansion of existing mines, opening of new mines, deployment of mass production technologies, first mile connectivity projects, and regular monitoring through the Project Monitoring Unit.

chunks.heading_path: GOVERNMENT OF INDIA MINISTRY OF COAL LOK SABHA UNSTARRED QUESTION NO. 3021 TO BE ANSWERED ON 10.03.2025 SAFETY IN COAL MINES
chunks.text:
GOVERNMENT OF INDIA MINISTRY OF COAL LOK SABHA UNSTARRED QUESTION NO. 3021 TO BE ANSWERED ON 10.03.2025 SAFETY IN COAL MINES
3021. SHRI SURESH PATEL: Will the Minister of COAL be pleased to state: (a) the measures taken for the safety of workers in coal mines; and (b) whether any technology has been deployed for early warning of hazards?

chunks.heading_path: ANSWER THE MINISTER OF COAL AND MINES (SHRI G. KISHAN REDDY)
chunks.text:
ANSWER THE MINISTER OF COAL AND MINES (SHRI G. KISHAN REDDY)
(a): Safety measures include risk-assessment based Safety Management Plans for every mine, safety audits by multidisciplinary teams, training of workers at vocational training centres, provision of personal protective equipment, and regular inspections by the Directorate General of Mines Safety. (b): Yes, Sir. Proximity warning systems on dumpers, real-time environmental monitoring for methane and carbon monoxide in underground mines, slope stability radar in large opencast mines and a mine-level safety dashboard have been deployed.
Press Information Bureau - Ministry of Coal (sample)

chunks.heading_path: Coal India registers record production of 773.6 million tonnes in FY 2023-24 (provisional)
chunks.text:
Coal India registers record production of 773.6 million tonnes in FY 2023-24 (provisional)
New Delhi, 1 April 2024. Coal India Limited closed financial year 2023-24 with a provisional production of 773.6 million tonnes, a growth of about 10 per cent over the previous year. Offtake stood at 753.5 million tonnes (provisional). The Ministry attributed the growth to faster statutory clearances, digital monitoring of mines and the commissioning of new first mile connectivity projects.
Provisional production, FY 2023-24 (Million Tonnes)

Chapter 3: Production
All India raw coal production during 2023-24 reached 997.83 million tonnes, compared with 893.19 million tonnes in 2022-23, a growth of 11.71 per cent. Coal India Limited contributed 773.81 million tonnes. The increase was driven by higher output from the large opencast mines of SECL and MCL, faster clearances for mine expansion, improved evacuation through first mile connectivity projects, and higher mechanisation with surface miners.
Table 3.1: Subsidiary-wise raw coal production of CIL (in Million Tonnes)
Table 3.2: Company-wise raw coal production, All India (in Million Tonnes)

Chapter 4: Offtake
Raw coal offtake by CIL during 2023-24 was 753.50 million tonnes against 694.70 million tonnes in 2022-23. Supply to the power sector accounted for about 80 per cent of the offtake. Coal stocks at pitheads remained comfortable through the year owing to improved rake availability.

chunks.text:
GOVERNMENT OF INDIA MINISTRY OF COAL RAJYA SABHA UNSTARRED QUESTION NO. 1187 TO BE ANSWERED ON 05.12.2024 REDUCTION IN COAL IMPORTS
1187. SMT. ANITA SHARMA: Will the Minister of COAL be pleased to state: (a) the steps taken by the Government to reduce import of coal; and (b) the status of the inter-ministerial committee on import substitution?

chunks.heading_path: ANSWER THE MINISTER OF COAL AND MINES (SHRI G. KISHAN REDDY)
chunks.text:
ANSWER THE MINISTER OF COAL AND MINES (SHRI G. KISHAN REDDY)
(a): To reduce substitutable coal imports the Government has taken steps including auction of commercial coal blocks, allowing captive mines to sell up to 50 per cent of production, single window clearance, enhancing domestic production of coking coal under Mission Coking Coal, and improving coal washing capacity. Thermal power plants designed on domestic coal have been advised to minimise blending with imported coal. (b): An Inter-Ministerial Committee was constituted to identify items that can be substituted by domestic coal. The committee meets regularly and a portal tracks import substitution by consumers.
